note_en: Both strains are real in the raw files, and they are used for different things. B. subtilis 168 is the strain in the May 2026 electroporation condition tests (4 May, 'electroporation competent B.sub 168 preparation'). WB800 is the strain from August onwards: electrocompetent cell preps on 8, 18 and 31 August and on 2 and 13 September; the Western blot sample '#J1 in Bacillus subtilis WB800' on 29 August; electroporation of ACDI into WB800 on 15 September and 1 October; and the Optogenetic LPA Assay protocol is titled 'CcaSR in B. subtilis WB800'. So 'every reactor number on this wiki is strain 168' and 'the chassis is WB800' can both be defensible, but which page should say what is an editorial call, not a raw-file one.
note_zh: 兩株在原始檔案裡都是真的，用途不同。B. subtilis 168 是 2026 年 5 月電穿孔條件測試用的菌株（5/4「electroporation competent B.sub 168 preparation」）。WB800 則是 8 月之後的菌株：8/8、8/18、8/31、9/2、9/13 製備電勝任細胞；8/29 的 Western blot 樣品「#J1 in Bacillus subtilis WB800」；9/15 與 10/1 把 ACDI 電穿孔進 WB800；Optogenetic LPA Assay 流程標題為「CcaSR in B. subtilis WB800」。所以「站上每個反應器數字都是 168」與「底盤是 WB800」可以同時成立，但哪一頁該寫哪一個是編輯判斷，不是原始檔案能決定的。

note_en: The OD window is in the SOP but the rest of the 168 column does not match any recorded 168 prep. The Electroporation SOP says to dilute 16-fold and grow at 37 C and 200 rpm 'to OD600 of 0.85~0.95', but then cools on ice for 10 min, spins at 5000 rpm for 5 min and resuspends in 1/40 of the culture volume. The only 168 prep in the notebook (4 May 2026, Gabriel) was grown to OD600 0.7, cooled 10 min, spun at 5000 g for 5 min and resuspended in 1/40. The combination the wiki puts in the 168 column (ice 5 min, 5,000 x g for 10 min, 1/20 volume) is what the 2 September 2026 WB800 prep did, so the 1/20 and 1/40 may be swapped between the two columns.
note_zh: OD 範圍確實在 SOP 上，但 168 那一欄的其餘條件和任何已記錄的 168 製備都不符。Electroporation SOP 寫稀釋 16 倍、37 °C 200 rpm 培養「to OD600 of 0.85~0.95」，但接著是冰上 10 分鐘、5000 rpm 離心 5 分鐘、以原體積 1/40 回溶。紀錄本裡唯一的 168 製備（2026/5/4，Gabriel）是培養到 OD600 0.7、冰上 10 分鐘、5000 g 離心 5 分鐘、1/40 回溶。wiki 放在 168 欄的組合（冰上 5 分鐘、5,000 x g 10 分鐘、1/20）其實是 2026/9/2 WB800 製備的做法，兩欄的 1/20 與 1/40 可能互換了。
